# Accepted terms for Tiger Data Docs.
# One term per line (case-insensitive regex). These are treated as correctly
# spelled, so Google's spelling rules don't flag them.
#
# IMPORTANT: do NOT list any term that TigerData.ProductConstants enforces —
# the product/brand names in src/constants.ts (Tiger Cloud, TimescaleDB,
# Tiger CLI, PostgreSQL, ...). The Vocab globally suppresses all rules for a
# term, which would silence that nudge; the enforced names live in
# .github/styles/TigerData/ProductConstants.yml. Correct usage writes those as
# {C.X} anyway. Feature, service,
# project, and pricing terms are NOT enforced, so they belong here.

# --- Tiger / Timescale terms accepted in prose (features and other
#     non-product terms; product/brand names are enforced, not listed) ---
Vectorizer
PgVectorizer
Livesync
Outflux
TimeWeightSummary
hypertables?
hypercore
hyperfunctions
rowstore
columnstore
